title: Assisted Living Apartment Transfer Fee: Calculation
content:
**Transfer fee.** Under the Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement, the transfer fee for an apartment move is the apartment change fee of the rate card, rounded once to the cent half up at the end.

**Current billing month.** The current billing month of the residency is the billing month of its most recent full-month rent charge.

| Item (hypothetical move) | Figure |
|---|---|
| Apartment change fee of the rate card | 650.00 |
| Transfer fee, rounded once to the cent | 650.00 |

The transfer fee is a single charge for the move; it is separate from the monthly rent of the new apartment, which runs from possession.
